baseline.name: B: Hard-LMM selected by earliest validation raw quantity RMSE
baseline.memory: one tied static key/value bank with 64 rows and hard cosine top-4 arithmetic-mean retrieval
baseline.optimizer: one-group AdamW followed by global gradient L2 clipping at 1.0
baseline.important_boundary: B has no online or test-time write; this probe concerns only outer-optimizer updates to selected prototype rows

diagnostic_scope.fold_role: directional stability between two whole-series-disjoint train cohorts; not out-of-sample performance
diagnostic_scope.series_fold_rule: reuse the exact two folds and stored order from hard_lmm_qkv_path_diagnostic_v1
diagnostic_scope.target_sampling: reuse the exact 4096 train target identities without resampling

selected_value_gradient.key_addressing_gradient: excluded because discrete hard top-4 membership has zero derivative
selected_value_gradient.quantity_strata: the five train-only quantity intervals already frozen in each launch contract: <=p50, p50-p90, p90-p95, p95-p99, >p99
selected_value_gradient.required_parity: analytic per-event aggregation must match native frozen-B lmm.mem gradients from the preceding aggregate probe within 2e-6 relative tolerance

single_mechanistic_probe.name: usage-normalized support-confidence prototype update
single_mechanistic_probe.classification: training-rule probe for the static Hard-LMM prototype bank; not an online memory write and not yet a Backbone architecture candidate

batch_formula.zero_rule: if either norm is zero, keep the original G_log batch gradient and mark the batch as having no candidate signal

single_mechanistic_probe.joint_update: replace only lmm.mem's log-quantity component G_log with T; preserve time gradient, every other parameter gradient, loss weights, batch size, and global clip 1.0
single_mechanistic_probe.uniform_usage_identity: when every row has equal support, norm matching must reproduce the B log-quantity memory gradient

controls.cyclic_row_shuffles: all 63 non-identity circular shifts of T across prototype row ids; preserve the row-update multiset and Frobenius norm
controls.shuffle_comparison: candidate log and raw incremental dot products must exceed the 95th percentile of the 63 shuffled controls

requirements_in_every_dataset_direction_.preserve_positive_hard_direction: when dot(held_metric_gradient, hard_b_update) > epsilon, the candidate absolute dot must remain > epsilon
requirements_in_every_dataset_direction_.shuffle_specificity: candidate incremental log and raw dot must be strictly above the 95th percentile across all 63 cyclic row shifts

prospective_gate.common_decision: implement a candidate only if every requirement passes for all three datasets, both fold directions, and both scopes
prospective_gate.failure_action: do not implement or GPU train this update rule; retain the diagnostic as evidence that the update boundary lacks a common necessary direction

integrity.checkpoint_and_cache_hashes: reuse and reverify every hash in hard_lmm_credit_assignment_probe_v1
integrity.target_use: target quantity and duration may construct diagnostic losses only; neither may change the query, top-4 membership, or history input
integrity.padding: padding positions contribute neither retrieval support nor gradient
integrity.model_state: frozen checkpoint state hash must match before and after; optimizer step is forbidden
integrity.output_reuse: cached B prediction, target, hidden, residual, and top-4 parity must remain within the preceding probe tolerances

interpretation_limits: This is a one-checkpoint first-order local diagnostic and does not predict finite-step e300 performance.
It does not reproduce AdamW moments, dropout, future top-4 membership changes, or weight decay effects.
A passing result would justify implementing a prototype training rule, not claiming a new inference-time Backbone structure.
A failing common gate rules out only this fixed usage-normalized support-confidence rule.
